newsitem.title: USA: Former Miami, Fla., manager Odio pleads guilty.
newsitem.headline: Former Miami, Fla., manager Odio pleads guilty.

text.p: Former Miami City Manager Cesar Odio pleaded guilty Wednesday to a federal charge of obstructing justice.
In exchange for the guilty plea, additional corruption charges against him were dropped.
Odio is scheduled to be sentenced on Aug. 20 and faces 10 to 16 months in prison under terms of the plea agreement, his attorney, Ed Shohat, said.
Odio resigned last fall after he was indicted on charges of conspiring to solicit a kickback from a computer company that sought a city contract.
"I feel better in the sense that my family has been under tremendous strain. I have not let anyone down," Odio said after entering the plea Wednesday before U.S. District Judge K. Michael Moore.
